parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json||{}; const secret=String(input.headers?.['x-ai-job-automation-webhook-secret']||''); if(!String($env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET||'')||secret!==String($env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET)) throw new Error('Webhook authentication failed'); const request=input.body||input; if(!request.presentation_key||!Array.isArray(request.canonical_member_keys)||!request.sheet_name||!request.columns) throw new Error('Invalid vacancy user state CRM sync request'); return [{json:request}];

Read Vacancy User State CRM Rows

parameters.jsCode: const request=$('Validate Vacancy User State CRM Sync').first().json; const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json||{}); const byKey=new Map(rows.map(r=>[String(r['CRM Key']||'').trim(),r]).filter(([k])=>k)); let matches=[]; if(byKey.has(String(request.presentation_key))) matches=[byKey.get(String(request.presentation_key))]; if(!matches.length) matches=rows.filter(r=>request.canonical_member_keys.includes(String(r['CRM Key']||'').trim())); if(!matches.length&&request.source==='hh'&&request.external_id){const id=String(request.external_id); matches=rows.filter(r=>new RegExp('(?:hh\.ru/vacancy/|backUrl=.*?/vacancy/)' + id + '(?:[^0-9]|$)','i').test(String(r['Ссылка']||'')));} if(matches.length!==1)return [{json:{found:false,error_code:matches.length?'crm_row_ambiguous':'crm_row_not_found'}}]; const row=matches[0],c=request.columns; return [{json:{found:true,'№':row['№']||row['No'],'CRM Key':request.presentation_key,'Мой приоритет':c['Мой приоритет']||'','Итог':c['Итог']||'','Комментарий':c['Комментарий']||''}}];
